question: Does the current exact context-signature representation preserve alias abstraction when equivalent raw surface families receive independent finite samples from the same underlying context distribution rather than byte-identical context-count histograms?
hypothesis: If the current contextual representation is robust to ordinary sampling variation, three equivalent surface aliases independently sampled sixty-four times from the same uniform sixteen-context distribution will still induce exactly nine three-member classes and transfer at least 0.90 accuracy to task-untrained family 2. A matched-sample positive control must retain nine correct classes and at least 0.95 transfer accuracy.

supersedes_unimplemented_preregistration.reason: R1 is the frozen cycle parent, so R2 restates the unchanged design with the operator-supplied parent as the direct qualification boundary

scientific_reuse.design: byte-identical to the frozen R1 preregistration except experiment identity, exact parent, and qualification-boundary metadata

prior_evidence.observation: A task-untrained third surface family achieved 1.0 accuracy on all 192 multi-step programs through exact context-signature alias classes.

scope_statement: This experiment attacks sampling robustness of the representation layer only. It does not reinterpret prior exact-signature results; it asks whether abstraction survives independent finite observations from the same latent context distribution.
authority: research-only; no deployment, external-model inference, scheduler, queue, accepted-ref, production, broker, or live-interface authority

arms_and_inputs.underlying_distribution: uniform over context_index 0..15 for every family and entity
arms_and_inputs.matched_seed: 0x243f6a88 XOR ((entity+1)*1009); identical sequence for all families of an entity
arms_and_inputs.independent_seed: 0x243f6a88 XOR ((entity+1)*1009) XOR ((family+1)*0x9e3779b9); distinct deterministic sequence per family
arms_and_inputs.task_training: families 0 and 1 only; 3200 single-step records from R5
arms_and_inputs.evaluation: all eighty family-2 single-step tasks, read-only

representation_and_prediction.surface_selection: top twenty-seven raw four-byte bridge windows by occurrence count descending then lexicographic raw key
representation_and_prediction.signature: complete sorted exact immediate-context-key occurrence map
representation_and_prediction.clustering: complete count signatures must be byte-identical
representation_and_prediction.missing_transition_behavior: predict lexicographically lowest observed output-class pair

controls: Matched arm shares each entity sample sequence across all three aliases.
Independent arm differs only in family-specific sampler seed.
Exact-surface control is trained on families 0 and 1 only.
No family label, semantic label, alias dictionary, tokenizer, external model, network access, capacity growth, approximate repair, or oracle correction enters learning.
validity_criteria: Exact parent, North Star, and sealed zero-shot multi-step evidence identity match.
Both arms use identical motifs, latent context keys, uniform distribution, sample count, task data, transition learner, and evaluator.
Arms differ only in whether aliases share the sampler seed.
Independent empirical histograms differ for at least one alias pair.
Class fragmentation is a scientific outcome, not an invalid row.
Semantic identity is evaluator-only after prediction.
All metrics are finite and full Go regression passes before the probe.
No tokenizer, external model, network call, capacity growth, approximate repair, threshold change, or adaptive evaluation occurs.

classification_rules.survives_falsification: Validity passes, matched control passes, and every independent-arm class and transfer threshold passes.
classification_rules.sampling_invariance_falsified: Validity passes, matched control has nine correct triplet classes and at least 0.95 accuracy, independent histograms differ, and independent classes fragment or independent accuracy is at most 0.25 with missing transition keys.
classification_rules.mixed: Validity passes and matched control succeeds, but independent behavior lies between survival and falsification criteria.
classification_rules.negative_control_failure: Matched control fails its class or transfer threshold.
classification_rules.incomplete: Compute interruption prevents the frozen matrix.
classification_rules.invalid: Any distribution, family2 leakage, evaluator-boundary, deterministic-state, or qualification criterion fails.

stop_conditions: Stop invalid before science on parent, North Star, construction, build, or frozen-package drift.
After output begins, complete both bridge arms and all eighty family2 evaluations unless infrastructure prevents it.
Do not alter sample size, seeds, representation, task data, capacity, budgets, metrics, or thresholds after observing output.
no_post_result_tuning_rule: No context distribution, sample count, seed, representation rule, transition model, control, metric, threshold, budget, capacity, or interpretation may change after primary output.
